title: Example Summit Business Center appraisal December 31, 2025
summary: Example Summit Business Center · As of December 31, 2025

evidence.quote: This appraisal of Example Summit Business Center, 2750 Example Summit Rd, Las Vegas, NV, was prepared by Example Valuation Advisors.
The effective date of value is December 31, 2025.
The date of this report is January 22, 2026.
The interest appraised is the leased fee interest.
The market value of the property, as is, is $72,750,000.
The income capitalization and sales comparison approaches were used for the 280,000 square feet in 64 units.
